description: Migration script for version 5.3.0 of OrangeHRM, handling database schema updates, data transformations, foreign key adjustments, and language string updates related to the Buzz social feature.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles database migration tasks for OrangeHRM version 5.3.0, including schema modifications, data conversions, foreign key management, and language string updates.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps: inserting permissions, updating language strings, modifying Buzz tables, converting times to UTC, and cleaning legacy config values.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database if they are null.

methods.name: createColumnToStoreBuzzOriginalVideoLink
methods.description: Adds a new column for original video links in the Buzz link table and populates it based on related post texts.

methods.name: modifyBuzzTables
methods.description: Drops obsolete tables/columns, alters character sets, manages foreign keys, and updates columns in Buzz-related tables.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Identifies foreign keys in specific tables that conflict with the 'hs_hr_employee' table.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign keys that conflict with the employee table, logging errors if any.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Re-adds foreign keys that were previously dropped if they are in the list of dropped constraints.

methods.name: changeBuzzTablesDateTimeColumnsAsNotNull
methods.description: Sets specific DateTime columns in Buzz tables to be NOT NULL.

methods.name: convertBuzzCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts comment time fields in the Buzz comment table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzLikeOnCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts like time fields in the Buzz like on comment table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzLikeOnShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts like time fields in the Buzz like on share table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzPostTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts post time fields in the Buzz post table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts share time fields in the Buzz share table to UTC.

methods.name: getTableRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the count of records in a specified table.

methods.name: convertServerTimeToUTCTime
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to UTC timezone.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance.
